en: The image depicts an old sepia-toned photograph of a large, rectangular, two-story brick building with a central clock tower. The building is surrounded by a garden with grass, trees, and several people, some dressed in white medical uniforms, others in dark uniforms or patient attire. The style and attire suggest an early 20th-century European setting. The text at the top of the postcard reads 'Chemnitz. Kgl. Garnisonlazarett. Krankenblock I.', which translates to 'Chemnitz. Royal Garrison Hospital. Hospital Block I.'
